Definition: from G4586; venerableness, i.e. probity:--gravity, honesty.
BiblicalUsage: Semnotes is gravity, honest weight, and Paul puts it in the prayer for rulers and the rule of the house: pray for kings and all in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty; and the overseer must rule well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gravity is the quiet fruit of a well-ruled house and a prayed-for ruler — a peaceable life is not an accident.
